title: Network activity
intro: Every destination Boba contacts, on your behalf, grouped by what it is for. Only the host and the time are kept — never a path, a search, a header or a message.
no_telemetry: There is no telemetry and no crash upload. Boba sends nothing anywhere on its own.
empty: Nothing has been contacted yet. Destinations appear here as soon as Boba reaches one.
fx.title: Salary conversion
fx.description: Salaries always show in their own currency. Turn this on to add a converted amount, with the date of the rate used. Off by default.
fx.on: Conversions are on. Each converted amount shows the date of its rate.
fx.off: Conversions are off. Salaries show in their original currency only.
fx.no_rate: No rate has been fetched yet.
fx.error: Exchange rates could not be turned on.
